title: Introduce column autosuggest and compact ARIA-friendly rows for virtualized tables
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: Existing virtualized table interactions are noisy for users with many columns and cause discoverability issues for column operations (resize, sort, pin). Density modes compress rows but hide affordances; keyboard/voice users struggle to find actions. Goal: design a compact density mode that preserves accessibility and introduces a contextual column autosuggest to help users discover column-level actions and quick-jump to columns without permanently increasing visual complexity.
background: Current designs compress UI by hiding column controls until hover which breaks keyboard and screen reader discoverability.
Engineering constraints: continuous virtualization (react-window), memoized cell rendering, and aggressive DOM recycling mean we must minimize per-row DOM nodes and avoid per-cell portals.
Related tickets: ENG-38912 (virtualization perf fixes), PM-2214 (table filter UX), DES-41208 (density tokens audit).
goals: Provide a compact density mode with single-row height reduction while keeping focusable controls reachable via keyboard and screen readers.
Introduce a keyboard-first column autosuggest (type-to-find column) that surfaces column operations (resize, sort, filter, pin) without expanding the column header toolbar.
Minimize rendering overhead so the change does not regress frame rate in large tables (>= 20k rows).
Ship a pattern that PG/ENG teams can reuse for charts and other grid-like components.
constraints: Must work with existing virtualization runtime (no change to virtualization lib this cycle).
Avoid adding DOM nodes per cell; prefer a single overlay for autosuggest and header action affordances.
Accessibility: comply with WAI-ARIA table patterns and ensure screen reader announces autosuggest results and actions.
Design tokens: use density tokens audit results from DES-41208 and not introduce new spacing tokens this cycle.
proposed_solutions: Compact row style: reduce vertical padding and line-heights, collapse header chrome to a single-line compact header while preserving an explicit focus ring target for keyboard users.

Column autosuggest: global keyboard shortcut (/) opens an overlay anchored to the table header; typing filters column list; arrow keys navigate; Enter opens context menu for the selected column (resize handles, sort, filter, pin).
Single overlay pattern: header overlay reused across virtualization (keeps DOM count constant). Overlay fetches column metadata from table schema and shows badges for active filters/sorts.

Resize affordance: show a thin, high-contrast resize rail on focus or when autosuggest action 'resize' is invoked; actual drag uses a portal that only mounts while dragging to avoid extra nodes per header.
acceptance_criteria: Compact density mode applied without increasing per-row DOM nodes (perf profile shows no >5% CPU increase on 20k rows).
Keyboard flow: / opens autosuggest, typing filters columns, Arrow/Enter actions accessible, Esc closes overlay.
Screen reader: autosuggest announces number of matches and each result with its column role; invoking column actions announces state changes (e.g., 'Sort ascending applied to Column X').
Design review approval from Design Lead and PM (sign-off recorded in comments).
Engineers confirm feasibility and merge readiness for ENG-38912 dependent changes.
design_notes: Figma prototype: compact header + autosuggest flow (https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/table-autosuggest-compact).
Use semantic table markup when virtualization allows; otherwise ensure overlay provides aria-labelledby to maintain relation between header and overlay.
Token mapping: small-row-height = spacing-1, compact-header-transform = translateY(-2px) to preserve baseline rhythm.
Visual language: keep column icons at 16px, reduce filler gutters to 6px, maintain min column width vis guidelines (min 72px).
decisions: Chose overlay autosuggest vs inline persistent header menus to avoid per-header DOM bloat.
Keyboard shortcut set to '/' (search-like) with fallback of Alt+K for users in non-US locales.
Will not introduce new density tokens this cycle; will reuse existing compact tokens and document trade-offs for next iteration.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: overlay may cause focus-management edge cases when virtualization recycles header nodes. Mitigation: manage focus with table-level focus manager that re-attaches active header context by column id, not DOM node.
Risk: autosuggest introduces a perceptible reflow on mobile narrow view. Mitigation: autosuggest falls back to a full-screen sheet on narrow viewports.
